title: The plot thickens with more hair growing products
summary: With 20-25% of American and UK women suffering from thinning hair, and 40% of men experiencing noticeable hair loss by the age of 35, more brands are spotting the growth potential of thickening products

extraction.key_fact: 가는 모발 고민이 많아지면서 모발 볼륨 제품에 뛰어드는 브랜드가 늘고 있다.
